title: A few pastilles of aconite
html_source: A few candies/lozenges of monkshood/wolfsbane, an extremely poisonous plant from the buttercup family.

anchor.prefix: iotism, sorrow for the dead, music, future of the race. To be or not to be. Life's dream is o'er. End it peacefully. They can live on. (He gazes far away mournfully.) I am ruined.
anchor.suffix:
. The blinds drawn. A letter. Then lie back to rest. (He breathes softly.) No more. I have lived. Fare. Farewell. 

1922#470

 ZOE 

(Stiffly, her finger in her neckfillet.) Honest
